description: Author a native Give Fixed Pickup on Enter rule on an original asymmetric arena. Verify the entering player receives a Dragon in room 1 while the physical pickup starts in room 2, then return to the unmodified original with the trigger draft retained.

required_lines: LEVELTOOL\.ROOMS: length=2100 width=1800 height=600 members=6 second_length=2700 doorway_width=500\.00 doorway_height=390\.00

required_sequences.name: Normal volume entry grants the weapon across rooms and the unsaved draft returns to Forge
patterns: SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: authored arena=mod:arena_grid_fixed_pickup_trigger provenance=original archive_sha256=[0-9a-f]{64} spawn=pad_0000 trigger=volume_pad_9999 pad=pad_0001 fixed=setup_0000 weapon=base:dragon pickup_pad=pad_0008
SCENARIO\.SOURCE: compiled setup\.fields\.json '[^']*grid_fixed_pickup_trigger[^']*'.* as 1 setup records, 1 spawns,
SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: before player=0 player_room=1 pickup_room=2 has_dragon=0 separation_x=[1-9][0-9]{3,}\.[0-9]
SCENARIO\.GRAPH: event\.volume\.entered '[^']*grid_fixed_pickup_trigger[^']*' volume=volume_pad_9999 player=0 modules=1 backend=graph\.level\.runner
SMOKE\.GRID\.PICKUP: after player=0 player_room=1 pickup_room=2 has_dragon=1 separation_x=[1-9][0-9]{3,}\.[0-9] volume=volume_pad_9999
